messages.subject: Re: Calibration using RSWAT for SWAT+ without using graphical user interface
parts:
There are several issues with your setup that RSWAT cannot run
1. extraction from the "hru_wb_day" file does not support by RSWAT (you need to define your own extraction function
2. if you have only one observed data file, the name must be "obs_var_1.txt", but you used "obs_var_2.txt"
Hope this helps
